AccessToken.id is serialized as the jti claim, and initToken now emits "<6 chars>:<uuid>" instead of a bare UUID for every access token, so anything parsing or storing jti as a UUID is affected — a genuine compatibility question for the maintainer.

Settled by running the JDK: for the real prefix "onrtac", substring(3,5) yields "ta" while substring(4,6) yields "ac", and the body returns false on a match. The helper therefore never validates the grant shortcut — every expectCodeToToken/expectRefresh/expectDeviceCodeToToken/expectAuthReqIdToToken assertion passes vacuously, and would fail if the index were corrected without also flipping the comparison.
